_source: heroes.exe 0x6739c, the computer player's buy routine, decoded 2026-10-03 (data/knowledge_base/research/ai-planner-decodes.md, 'Buy choice'). Checked against the original's own AI log (KB.LOG, day 1 of a Claw game) and the autosave of the same game: every building, creature and Warlock tavern-hero Raw BC matches. Code addresses are file offsets, data addresses data-object offsets.
_comment: Each round every town offers its best building, best creature stack and best tavern hero; the best score over all towns is bought and the round repeats. Scores are benefit per gold-equivalent cost.

player_weights._comment: Set at the start of each AI turn (0x69502). ad, b1 and b5 are the player floats at +0xad, +0xb1, +0xb5; b5 is 0.3 times the factor of the first day_factor row whose 'before' exceeds the day.

resource_worth._comment: 0x73ade / 0x69625: stock[r] = trunc((amount + income_days x income_weight x daily income) x base); mean = sum(stock) / 7 (integer); worth[r] = base / (ratio_weight x stock / mean + ratio_offset). Gold is worth about 0.6 on day 1.

army_value._comment: Player float +0xf9 = (gold + daily gold income) / (plain rating of every hero army and garrison + rating_offset) + b1.

affordability._comment: 0x73c74: days = (cost - stock) / income + 1 for each short resource (no_income_days without income); factor = max(0, 1 - per_day x the largest).

late_term._comment: The stub 0x71078 always outputs 0.09. Buildings get x (1 - 3 x 0.09) = 0.73, creatures x (0.09 + 0.96)^3.

noise._comment: RandBC = Raw x (base + random(lo..hi)) / 100 ranks options inside a town; each town's best of a kind is then scored with Raw x (100 - random(0..candidate_max)) / 100.

buildings._comment: Base values (0xd0370). The Mage Guild is valued and priced at its level byte (town +0x18, built levels counted from 0, so 0 both without a guild and with one level): the value at that index less the one below. The computer offers it while the byte is below guild_max_byte, so level 4 is the last it builds. Dwellings are listed by tier.

building_factors._comment: n = dwellings built in the town. mage_guild: x (2 ad + 0.33) x (1.33 - 0.33 x the player's guilds at level 0, a count that is always 0). tavern: x garrison rating / tavern_rating. well: x (ad + 0.66) x (2 b1 + 0.33) x (0.66 + 0.33 n). castle: x (2 ad + 0.33) x (1.6 - 0.2 n). dwelling: x (ad + 0.66) x (2 b1 + 0.33) x (1 - 0.05 x the player's towns of this faction that have it), x (1.66 - 0.33 n) below the highest built tier, x 1.1 with a well, 0 when a built dwelling with stock holds a creature whose rank x 1.2 exceeds this one's.

creature_rank._comment: Byte +4 of each creature record (data 0x1fcaa + 28 x id). Only used to compare dwellings.

creatures._comment: n = gold / unit gold cost, halved above 1, capped at the stock, 0 unless at least min_count. B = n x rating x f9; with a hero in the town x hero_bonus, x class_bonus more when the creature's faction is the hero's class, x (heavy_base - heavy_per_stack x heavy stacks in the hero's army) for heavy units, x (b1 + b1_offset); heavy units also x (heavy_base - heavy_per_stack x heavy stacks in the garrison). Every step truncates.
creatures._comment_share: Per round: b = garrison rating + 400 per town, m = trunc(sum b / sum w) with w 10 for a castle and 7 for a town, a = w x m + 400. A town's creature score is x (a / b / 3 + 0.66).

heroes._comment: Tavern heroes, only while the player has fewer heroes than the cap and the town has a castle. V = base + XP + XP / 2 + artifact values; x (1 + b5 - b1); x class_bonus when the hero's class pairs with the town (class_bonus_town); + location potential (0x73410) - potential_offset; x affordability. A hero on the town's gate takes gate_penalty off the score.
heroes._comment_class: The exe compares the hero's class byte (Knight, Barbarian, Sorceress, Warlock) with the town's faction byte (Knight, Sorceress, Barbarian, Warlock), so Barbarian and Sorceress cross. Day 1 of the log agrees: only this reading gives both tavern heroes of a town the same potential term.
heroes._comment_potential: 0x73410 at (0, 0): on Day 1 for side 1, the BSS cache is uninitialized (0); for sides 2 and 3 on Day 1, starting heroes have target (-1, -1) at Manhattan distance 2 from (0, 0), giving a crowding penalty of (9-2)*1250/9*1.25 = -1215. On Day 2+, all heroes are on the map (d >= 9 from (0, 0)), so potential is 0.
heroes._comment_cap: 0x31ea4: 4 when byte 0x43e81 - byte 0x43e83 is 2, read as 'two players left'; inferred, not proven.
heroes._comment_bonus: Before the turn's first hire, after bonus_after_day and when the score is positive: + add when gold income >= income_add and heroes < cap - 2, else x scale when income >= income_scale and heroes < cap - 1. Otherwise + add when the player has no hero.

artifact_values._comment: AI value of each artifact (data 0x1fb20 by native id). The spell book has none.

naval._comment: Requests from the planner. An open shipyard request builds the shipyard when it can, else holds back shipyard_hold for the rest of the buy; a boat request buys a boat when the shipyard stands and boat_hold is there, else holds it back.
